questions.question: When approaching an uneven surface like a bump or pothole, you should rise slightly off your seat:

options.text: So you can jump off the motorcycle if needed.
So your legs can absorb the shock.
So other drivers can see you better.
So you can see the uneven surface better.

questions.correctAnswerText: So your legs can absorb the shock.
questions.explanation: When riding over an uneven surface, rising off your seat lets your joints absorb some of the impact. This helps prevent the surface from throwing you off the motorcycle.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. It only takes a few minutes and helps you avoid dangerous problems before you ride.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the most protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol, you should:

options.text: Decide if you can ride based on how you feel after drinking.
Set a limit beforehand so you can ride safely.
Not worry about riding if you feel fine.

questions.explanation: Do not ride after drinking any alcohol. Any amount of alcohol can affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: What can happen if you take a turn too fast?

options.text: It is safe as long as you stay under the speed limit.
It is safer on a motorcycle than in a car.
It is safe if no other vehicles are nearby.
You may end up in another lane or leave the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may end up in another lane or leave the road.
questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast is dangerous. You may not be able to hold the turn and could end up in another lane or off the road. Always use caution when turning.

questions.question: What is usually found in the center of the lane?
questions.explanation: Car drippings form an oily strip in the center of each lane. Unless it is wet, motorcycles can usually ride safely on this strip.

questions.question: Can clothing help prevent injuries in a crash?

options.text: No, clothing is just a personal choice.
Yes, but only if clothing is loose and flaps in the wind.
Yes, if a jacket and pants cover your arms and legs completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, if a jacket and pants cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: The right clothing reduces crash injuries. Choose a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs, are made of sturdy material, and fit snugly so they do not flap in the wind.

questions.question: If someone is tailgating you, what should you do?
questions.explanation: The best way to handle a tailgater is to let them pass. If it is safe, change lanes and let them go in front of you. Riding faster will only increase danger.

questions.question: When should you do a complete check of your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need more frequent checks than cars. Do a complete check before every ride.

questions.question: When alcohol and drugs are used together, their effects:

options.text: Can be stronger than when either is used alone.
Are less dangerous than when either is used alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be stronger than when either is used alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, can impair your riding. Some medications become more dangerous when mixed with alcohol.

questions.question: A rectangular sign can be a:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about road rules. Speed limit signs are rectangular, white with black lettering. You must follow the rules on these signs.

questions.question: Which item does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: For protection, wear a DOT-approved helmet, eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots that support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: If you wait one hour after drinking one alcoholic drink before riding:

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drunk driving.
Alcohol will not affect your riding skills.
Alcohol effects may still be present.
You will be fine if you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol effects may still be present.
questions.explanation: Your body eliminates about one drink per hour. However, alcohol can build up in your system even at one drink per hour. This buildup can still affect your riding ability.

questions.question: When adjusting your rearview mirror, make sure you can see:

options.text: The lane behind you and the lane next to you.
Only the lane next to you.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane behind you and the lane next to you.
questions.explanation: Adjust your mirrors to see the lane behind you and as much as possible of the lane beside you. The road behind and to the side of you is most important to see.

questions.question: What color is a warning sign with black lettering or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: Which type of clothing helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that makes you and your motorcycle visible to other drivers. Bright, reflective clothing makes it easier for others to see you.

questions.question: If a friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Tell them to use less-crowded roads.
Get other friends to talk them out of riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get other friends to talk them out of riding.
questions.explanation: Never let someone ride if they have drunk too much. Do everything you can to stop them from riding. Getting a group of friends to apply peer pressure can help.

questions.question: When choosing a protective jacket or pants, look for items made of:
questions.explanation: Wear long pants and a jacket to cover your arms and legs while riding. Leather provides the best protection.

questions.question: Downshifting to a lower gear is also called:
questions.explanation: Shifting to a lower gear slows your motorcycle like using the brakes. This is why downshifting is called engine braking.

questions.question: A leather jacket:

options.text: Is too warm to wear when riding.
Should not be worn while riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved jacket, preferably leather, for protection while riding. In warm weather, a leather jacket can help prevent dehydration. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool in hot weather.

questions.question: How can you make your motorcycle more visible?

options.text: Add extra lights to your motorcycle.
Do not use your turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Add extra lights to your motorcycle.
questions.explanation: To be more visible, wear bright or reflective clothing. You can also add extra lights to your motorcycle, use your turn signals, and flash your brake light when needed. These actions help other drivers see you.

questions.question: What should you do when riding a motorcycle on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: When riding on slippery surfaces, slow down. Use both brakes when you need to stop. Avoid making sudden movements.

questions.question: If your motorcycle has no windshield or windscreen, what must you do?

options.text: The motorcycle is breaking the law.
You must wear goggles, glasses, or a protective face shield.
You can only ride between dusk and sunset.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must wear goggles, glasses, or a protective face shield.
questions.explanation: Vermont law requires that if your motorcycle has no windshield, you must wear goggles, glasses, or a protective face shield while riding.

questions.question: What type of footwear should you wear while riding?

options.text: Shoes with long laces that hang loose.

questions.explanation: Wear boots or shoes that are tall and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles. Heels should be short so they do not catch on surfaces. Laces should be tucked in so they do not get caught in the motorcycle's moving parts.

questions.question: When riding behind a car, where should you position your motorcycle?

options.text: In the part of the lane closest to the edge of the road.
In the center of the lane where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
As close to the car as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the center of the lane where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Ride in a position where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror. This is usually the center of the lane. Drivers check their rearview mirrors more often than their side mirrors, so this position helps them see you.
